value.reason: The ticket lacks required details (invoice identifier, exact charge date, amount, reason, subscription status) needed to evaluate a refund review request. The policy confirms a 14-day review window exists, so a reply asking for these specifics is a safe next step.

groundedReply.suggestedResponse: Thank you for reaching out. I'd like to help you request a refund review. Since charges can be reviewed within 14 days of the transaction, could you please provide the following details: 1) the invoice or transaction ID for the charge, 2) the exact date of the charge, 3) the amount charged, 4) the reason you're requesting a refund, and 5) your current subscription status (active, canceled, etc.)? Once I have this information, I can submit it for review. Please note that a review does not guarantee approval.

citations.claim: Refunds are not automatic; customers may request review within 14 days of the charge, and support must not guarantee approval.
